headline: Thursday, November 19 — the storm exits this morning, and the evening runs dry for the show

sections.lead: Rain quits by early afternoon; tonight is dry for Berkeley.
items: Today: light rain early, tapering to nothing by 2pm, high 56/low 46, west gusts to 18 mph.
Fri: sunny 55/38. Sat: 51/37. Sun: 51/41. Mon: 51/41, full moon that night.
Tue Nov 24: the next real soaker, rain 75%, about 1.4 inches.

sections.lead: Moon in Pisces, waxing toward Monday's full moon; the sweet spot and the snag both point at communication and comfort.
items: Venus is parked right on your natal Moon (Libra 25°, orb about 1.8°) — comfort and connection run strong, and it has been sitting there for days.
Mercury squares your natal Sun from Scorpio 8.7°, nearly exact (orb 0.3°) — words rub the wrong way today; keep messages short, double-check anything you sign.
Saturn (Aries 11.2 R) still trines your natal Sun (2.7°) and Neptune (Aries 2.1 R) trines your natal Venus (1.0°) — steady spine, quiet lift underneath.
Moon Pisces 22°, waxing gibbous ~75%; full moon lands Monday Nov 23.
Plain version: a soft, foggy-feeling day that ends warm and dry — perfect for a show; save stiff conversations for after the weekend.

Zero new passed the filters. LinkedIn repeats Vulcan Asphalt Napa ($28-32/hr, under the floor) and Lloyd W Aubry Hayward (industrial mechanical, wrong lane); ZipRecruiter's visible cards are low-pay non-construction; Indeed blocked me again (login wall).
Tracker stays at 49 leads awaiting your Apply / Not-for-me.
Antioch police arrested a 19-year-old in Tuesday night's fatal shooting near D and West 19th, with a witness's help (CBS SF).
Wednesday's storm left downed trees, flight delays, outages and a few landslides around the Bay (SF Chronicle).
Wind warning wraps up as the rain exits; the next soaker is Tuesday (NWS).
Nothing new from Ashby, Greenhouse or any other board.
Easy win: rest — you're three days out from surgery and today's calendar is almost empty.
9am: Thanksgiving prep prompt lands (a week to go).
Autopilots: 10am apply run, 3pm sweep, 5pm site check, 6pm purge.
SDI: the DE 2501 paper form is in the mail (ordered Nov 17, up to 10 days); next mail check Mon Nov 23.
Tonight: As I Lay Dying at Cornerstone, doors 7pm, show 7:30pm.

sections.lead: Drive is 48 min each way at showtime; BART runs direct.
items: Leave home by 6pm to make the 7pm doors (45-50 min via CA-4 W and CA-24).
Back leg ~46 min; leave the venue by 10:45pm to miss the worst of the late traffic.
BART option: Antioch station Yellow line direct to Downtown Berkeley (~45 min), then a 7-minute walk.
Tony's calendar and the Family calendar are both quiet today.
